_comment: Standard hybrid CTC/attention ASR (greek_asr.models.attention). max_steps/batch_size/gradient_accumulation_steps are left pending: Serdar's pilot (section 7 of docs/HANDOFF_ADNAN_TR.md) must measure real step time/VRAM before a non-arbitrary training-length decision. See docs/SEQUENCE_MODELS.md.
architecture: Listen, Attend and Spell encoder-decoder with an auxiliary CTC head (hybrid CTC/attention)
primary_sources: Chan, Jaitly, Le, Vinyals (2016), Listen, Attend and Spell, arXiv:1508.01211
Watanabe et al. (2017), Hybrid CTC/Attention Architecture for End-to-End Speech Recognition, IEEE JSTSP
toolkit: plain PyTorch/torchaudio (no ESPnet/SpeechBrain/WeNet dependency added); see docs/SEQUENCE_MODELS.md 'Toolkit choice'
